data.novelty: fresh trajectories in existing opening families; exclude all v0.10 labels and all v0.11 collected roots, including mirrors
data.rootRule: one noncheck cp-only root per trajectory, abs(best teacher cp)<=250, ply>=16, closest to offset24; skip if none

quality.commonCandidateUnion: all variants AND both node budgets for each root

matches.adjudication: terminal and repetition only; move cap unresolved

statistics: paired trajectory bootstrap 5000 replicates; no Elo; no test-outcome tuning

amendment.reason: Gap MAE fell but validation rank accuracy barely changed; prevent scale collapse before opening test outcomes
amendment.rankDecision: No checkpoint beat the original validation rank agreement; selected epoch 0 = base. Reject rank trial; later projected checkpoints also became numerically unstable.
